entry.title: Self-Taught, No Bootcamp, First Dev Job: Exactly What I Did
entry.summary:
My previous posts were about life after I landed the job; this one is about how I landed it, how long it took and what it took. I didn’t do a bootcamp. I couldn’t afford it, and my English wasn’t good enough to follow one anyway. So I learned on trains and after work: docs, blogs, a few courses, Discord servers, whatever I could stick in my head without it sliding out.
I did all of this while working full-time at a small mom-and-pop shop, studying on the train and after my shift. For the first six months, my brain rejected everything. I’d read MDN for an hour and remember three words. Somewhere around month six, it stopped hurting. A “hello world” turned into a todo app, then a simple site. Tiny dopamine hits kept me going. Then I tried to get a job.
